'''Dorajan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CE" /> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] within [[Lannik Space/Legends|Lannik Space]],<ref name="EAOC" /> densely covered in [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]].<ref name="CE" /> Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3]]–[[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Last Chance (YT-1300 light freighter)/Legends|ship]] of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]] was shot down by [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] from an Imperial orbital outpost as she attempted to flee with an unlicensed shipment of heavy [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] of Imperial manufacture. Okeefe was forced to land her ship in the jungle of Dorajan and hurriedly begin repairs, fearing that her location could soon be detected by a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] in orbit, which might then dispatch a heavily-armed someone to collect her.<ref name="SE" />
